quote: PR-4 Link lifetime. A password reset link stays valid until it is used or until the customer asks for a newer link. / PR-3 One-time use. A password reset link can be used once.

EX-4 Batch exports. Exports produced by the nightly batch are written to the shared directory `/shared/exports/<date>/`. / EX-2 Tenant isolation. An export file can be read only by the tenant that requested it.

RF-4 Refund method. Refunds return to the original payment method. Store credit is issued only when the customer chooses it. / RF-3 Refund obligation. A customer who cancels an order or returns an item within the allowed window is refunded the full price paid for it
NO-2 Opt-out. A customer who opts out of marketing notifications receives none of them, on any channel, from the moment the preference is saved.
The worker retries a failed delivery up to 8 times with exponential backoff and marks it `FAILED` after the ninth failed attempt. This revision keeps the retry bound of the retry policy intact.

RL-5 Excess requests. Requests above the limit are rejected with HTTP 429 and a `Retry-After` header. The server then repeats the rejected request on the client's behalf, as described in RL-2. / RL-4 Limit. Each API key may send at most 100 requests per minute.
